# Equinox Audio Visuals

> Event production with character. Hospitality-minded technical production for weddings, galas, and corporate events across New England and beyond. Est. 2023, Manchester, Vermont.

Equinox is a technical producer — not a commodity gear rental house. Proof lives in named venues, specific run-of-show, and calm show-day execution. Primary CTA sitewide: "Start a project" (never "Get a Quote").

Contact: https://www.eqxav.com/contact.html
Site: https://www.eqxav.com/

## Services

- [All services](https://www.eqxav.com/services.html): Audio, lighting, video/projection, and live production support
- [Weddings](https://www.eqxav.com/services-weddings.html): Ceremony audio, reception lighting, band/DJ support, toast mics
- [Corporate & conferences](https://www.eqxav.com/services-corporate.html): Wireless audio, hybrid/streaming, presenter support, stage lighting
- [Galas & non-profits](https://www.eqxav.com/services-galas.html): Auction audio, impact video, atmospheric lighting, ask-moment production
- [Process](https://www.eqxav.com/process.html): Six steps from first email to load-out

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://www.eqxav.com/work.html): Named case studies — corporate & community, weddings
- Representative venues: Hildene, Equinox Resort, Bennington Museum, Kimpton Taconic, Arlington Common, Crooked Ram, Northshire Day School
